title: A poisoned note cannot reach SessionStart without the banner
what: The SessionStart recall injection is the highest-leverage place for a hostile note to sit. All injected memory must be wrapped in the untrusted-data banner, and a distrusted writer's note must be left out of the pre-prompt injection entirely.

steps.title: {{proj}} operational note
steps.body: Operational note {{tok}} about the nightly job.

expect.desc: the SessionStart injection wraps all memory in the untrusted-data banner
the trusted note is injected (so the banner is not vacuously present)
a distrusted writer's note is left out of the pre-prompt injection
